name: JHS
author: Tone Zone
description: Pedals inspired by JHS Pedals: hand-painted boxes with hand-drawn art – the Daybreak Bloom, the nine-voice Tiny Tree, Grumpy Chuck, Kilt-style tartan fuzz, a nine-way rat pack, a console-style preamp, tape and bucket-brigade delays, spring reverb, uni-vibe, chorus, tremolo, dual overdrives and the minimal Trio Series (overdrive, distortion, fuzz, delay, reverb, chorus, compressor, phaser).
